_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see config/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Socket file of the private billing service the app connects to; empty turns billing off and every account keeps what it has.
settings.notes: Absolute path; read when the API starts. The folder must be mounted into the API container. Set to null to turn billing off.

settings.description: System account id that must own the billing service's socket; any other peer is refused.
settings.notes: Required with a socket path; read when the API starts.

settings.description: Seconds the app waits for the billing service to answer a request, such as a payment link, before showing Billing unavailable.
examples: billing links time out after 20 seconds
